scientific_integrity: All classifications and expectations are claimed from the self-contained analytic proof; the finite enumerator is an independent consistency test, not a proof for unbounded parameters. No independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to contiguous antisquare factors of four-run binary words. It does not establish a bound for larger run counts; the mean has an additive bounded additive remainder. The published run-parity lemma is explicitly prior work. Unindexed equivalent results remain a residual originality risk.
title: Antisquare-factor spectrum and sharp extremizers for four-run binary words
